title: A version line
description: One carrier's version, the same eight fields in every world (nix, clusters). One JSON object per line (JSON Lines). Agreed by ❄️ (nix) and ☸️ (clusters), 2026-10-28.

name.description: A stable id of the carrier: a Component slug, or a nix carrier's name.

source.description: Where WE pin it, `<repo>:<path>`: the file a bump edits.

pinned.description: The pinned version, verbatim (a leading `v` kept, or a revision).

latest.description: The highest STABLE upstream version, verbatim; null when unreachable.

level.description: The largest semver part that differs, pinned to latest; null when current or unknown. Informative: the bump gate is a separate input.

status.description: current: pinned is latest. behind: an upstream is newer. ahead: pinned is newer than any stable. unknown: unreachable, or not comparable.

upstream.description: Where `latest` comes from: github:<owner/repo>, helm:<index>#<chart>, oci:<registry/repo>, nixpkgs:<input>#<attr>, flake:<input>, or none.
